caption: Two wet ice cubes straight from the freezer are pressed together for a moment and let go, and they stay stuck as one piece.

sa.check: Two ice cubes are held, wet from the freezer.
The cubes look wet at the start.
The order is press, release, stay stuck.

pc.expect: The cubes are hard solids that meet face to face and join at the film of water between them, and the join holds when the pair is lifted or tilted.
pc.fail: The cubes squash or deform where they are pressed; or the pair bends at the join like a hinge; or the cubes merge into one smooth block with no seam; or the join stretches as the pair is lifted.

pc.expect: Two cubes throughout: they stay two pieces stuck together and neither appears, vanishes nor grows.
pc.fail: The two cubes merge into a single larger cube with no seam; or a third cube appears; or a cube vanishes; or the pair ends larger than the two cubes were.

pc.expect: After the hands let go the cubes stay in contact along the pressed faces with nothing else holding them.
pc.fail: The cubes fall apart as the hands open; or the cubes slide off each other and drop; or the pair holds together with a gap between the faces; or one cube hangs from the other without touching it.

pc.expect: The stuck pair rests or hangs under its own weight and falls if let go entirely, and meltwater runs downward off it.
pc.fail: The pair floats when released; or a cube rises away from the other; or meltwater runs up a cube's face; or the pair hangs in the air with the hands gone.

pc.expect: The cubes stay outside each other, touching at their faces, and nothing passes through either cube or through the hands.
pc.fail: One cube passes into the other; or a finger passes through a cube; or a cube passes through the surface it rests on; or a cube passes through the other and out the far side.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The cubes' clear look, the hands and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: A cube turns a colour; or the surface under them changes pattern; or the background changes between frames.

note: The hands are kept because pressing is the caption's action; they are otherwise not judged.
